exposure: Maternal serum insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) levels
Maternal serum brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) levels
Neonatal umbilical cord blood IGF-1 levels
Neonatal umbilical cord blood IGF-1R levels
Neonatal umbilical cord blood BDNF levels
cohort: The study included 87 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and their neonates, alongside a control group of 87 healthy pregnant women and their neonates.
finding: Pregnant women with GDM and their neonates exhibited a higher incidence of neonatal brain injury and specific alterations in maternal and neonatal umbilical cord serum levels of IGF-1, IGF-1R, and BDNF, which were correlated with neonatal brain injury.
cross-section timing: At delivery and shortly after birth
